tools.name: Grammarly
tools.desc: Improve writing with AI-powered grammar checks and suggestions
pros: Ready to use out of the box, no local install or maintenance
Free tier available, try before you upgrade
cons: Advanced features and higher limits usually require a paid plan
usage:
Step: Open the official site and sign up
Click the red "Visit official site" button to open the Grammarly homepage. Find "Sign Up" and log in with email or Google/GitHub.
Tip:
If the site won’t load, check your connection or try another browser.

Step: Pick the plan that fits you
New users usually get a free trial or free quota. Start with the Free tier before upgrading.
Check:
After sign-up you should see the Dashboard home.

Step: Create your first task / project
Click "New" or "Create New" and follow the guide. Pick the first template to start.
Tip:
Don’t start with a complex request. Test with one simple sentence, e.g. "Summarize this page into 3 points".

Step: Review and save the result
When done, the tool shows the result. Export, copy the link, or save locally.
Check:
If unhappy, click "Regenerate" or tweak the prompt and try again.
tools.detail: Grammarly is an AI-powered writing assistant designed to enhance the quality of your written content. It provides real-time grammar, punctuation, and style checks, as well as suggestions for improving clarity and effectiveness. Key features include advanced spell-checking, sentence structure analysis, and tone detection. It is ideal for developers, writers, and anyone who wants to communicate more effectively. Grammarly is available as a browser extension and integrates with popular platforms like Google Docs and Microsoft Word. Pros include its ability to catch a wide range of errors and its seamless integration with various writing tools. Limitations include the potential for false positives and the need for a subscription to access all features.

tools.detail: OneTab is a browser extension that helps you save hundreds of tabs by consolidating them into a single tab. This feature is particularly useful for developers who frequently work with multiple tabs to research, reference, or compare information. Key features include the ability to save tabs for later, organize them into groups, and restore them with a single click. OneTab is compatible with all major browsers and can help reduce memory usage and improve overall browser performance. Pros include its ability to declutter your browser and its ease of use. Limitations may include the lack of advanced tab management features and the need to manually organize tabs into groups.

tools.detail: LastPass is a password manager that securely stores and manages your passwords across all your devices. It uses strong encryption to protect your data and offers features like password generation, auto-fill, and multi-factor authentication. This tool is ideal for developers and anyone who needs to manage a large number of passwords securely. Key features include a password vault, secure sharing of passwords, and access to your passwords from any device. LastPass also includes a password strength checker and a feature to alert you if any of your passwords have been compromised. Pros include its robust security features and ease of use. Limitations may include the need to pay for premium features and the potential for users to forget their master password.

It runs user scripts on web pages to modify their behavior, allowing you to customize your browsing experience. This tool is particularly useful for developers who want to streamline their workflow or for anyone looking to automate repetitive tasks on the web. Key features include support for a wide range of user scripts, easy installation and management of scripts, and the ability to create custom scripts. Tampermonkey is compatible with all major browsers and can be used to block ads, speed up page loading, and much more. Pros include its flexibility and the vast library of available scripts. Limitations may include the potential for scripts to cause conflicts or slow down your browser, and the need to have some technical knowledge to create custom scripts.

Key features include the ability to clip entire web pages, select specific text and images, and save notes and tags. The Web Clipper also allows you to sync your clips across all your devices. It is compatible with all major browsers and integrates seamlessly with the Evernote app. Pros include its ease of use and the ability to organize and access your clips from anywhere. Limitations may include the need to have an Evernote account and the potential for clips to be incomplete if the page is updated or changed.

tools.detail: The JSON Viewer tool is a powerful browser extension designed to simplify the process of inspecting and editing JSON data directly within the browser. This tool is particularly useful for developers who frequently work with JSON files, as it allows for a more intuitive and efficient way to view and modify JSON data without the need to switch between different applications. Key features of the JSON Viewer include a user-friendly interface that provides a clear and structured view of JSON data, support for nested objects and arrays, and the ability to expand and collapse sections for easier navigation. The tool also offers syntax highlighting to enhance readability and a search function to quickly locate specific values or keys within the JSON structure. It is ideal for both beginners and experienced developers, as it caters to a wide range of JSON manipulation needs. While the JSON Viewer is highly effective for its intended purpose, it may lack advanced features that some developers might require for complex JSON data manipulation tasks.

tools.detail: Octotree is a browser extension that transforms the file navigation experience on GitHub and GitLab repositories. It adds a file tree sidebar to the left-hand side of the page, allowing users to quickly browse through the project's files and directories. This tool is a game-changer for developers who need to navigate large codebases efficiently. Key features of Octotree include a clean and intuitive interface, support for multiple file types, and the ability to expand and collapse directories for better organization. It also supports keyboard shortcuts for quick navigation and integrates seamlessly with the GitHub and GitLab platforms. Octotree is particularly beneficial for developers working on collaborative projects, as it streamlines the process of finding and accessing code. However, it may not be as effective for users who prefer the traditional file navigation methods provided by the native GitHub and GitLab interfaces.

tools.detail: CodePen is an online platform that serves as a playground for front-end developers to test, share, and learn HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code. It allows users to create and experiment with code snippets in a sandboxed environment, making it an invaluable tool for developers of all skill levels. Key features of CodePen include a simple and intuitive interface, the ability to create and save multiple pens (code snippets), and the option to fork existing pens to modify and learn from others' code. CodePen also supports live preview, allowing developers to see the results of their code changes in real-time. It is an excellent resource for learning new techniques, debugging code, and showcasing one's work to the community. The platform is particularly popular among beginners for its educational value and among experienced developers for its collaborative features. However, some users may find the platform less suitable for complex projects that require extensive debugging or integration with other tools.
